Literature reference for major-cell annotation and subcluster annotation in thymoma / thymic carcinoma scRNA-seq.
Gene symbols are semicolon-separated. These are representative annotation markers, not exhaustive differential-expression gene lists.
High = explicitly stated or clearly shown in a labeled marker plot; Moderate = figure/cluster-supported but the source provides a less unique marker definition.
Do not assign a cell type from a single marker alone. Check co-expression, exclusion markers, sample/patient distribution, QC/doublets, and biological context.
Tumor TEC states can deviate from normal cTEC/mTEC programs. For malignant epithelial annotation, combine epithelial markers with CNV/aneuploidy inference when feasible.
